name: com.baseprojectpackages.services
description: The runtime kernel every other Base package builds on: a service locator with typed registration and destroyed-object aware lookups, a GameServiceBehaviour base that registers and deregisters itself, a scene bootstrapper for persistent, per-scene and gameplay manager prefabs, an ordered shutdown pipeline, and priority trackers that resolve which of several competing callers currently owns a piece of global state. Zero dependencies beyond the Base Utility and Base Attributes packages.
